The CompanyUndagrid is part of the EnOcean group and delivers end-to-end asset tracking and IoT solutions that give customers in aviation, logistics and industry full visibility of their assets, equipment and operations. The Undagrid platform combines self-powered and battery-driven sensor devices with BLE-based indoor positioning, GPS/GNSS outdoor tracking and cellular IoT connectivity, and turns the resulting data into dashboards, analytics and reports that customers rely on every day. We are the leader in sensing and control products for IoT infrastructures and combine it with energy harvesting technologies for maintenance-free solutions that gain their energy from the environment enabling a sustainable world.The Role & YouYou are the technical face of our asset tracking platform towards our worldwide customer base. Working side by side with Sales, Product Management and Engineering, you guide customers from the first platform demonstration through deployment, training and day-to-day operations, and make sure they get measurable value out of our solutions. As an integral part of a global Customer Success team, you combine hands-on platform expertise with a strong feel for our customers’ business processes, and you turn what you learn in the field into better products.This position can be based in either Munich (Germany) , Copenhagen (Denmark) or Utrecht (the Netherlands) . We are recruiting for one role and will hire one candidate . The employment contract will be concluded with the local EnOcean entity at the selected location. Please apply only once and indicate your preferred location.#LI-HybridWhat you’ll be doing• Act as the primary technical counterpart in customer meetings alongside Sales and PM, and build strong relationships with technical, operational and management stakeholders on the customer side• Deliver compelling platform demonstrations and showcase advanced functionality in a way that creates confidence and excitement with customers• Support solution design and deployment planning for new customer projects, and support our customers worldwide in deploying EnOcean and Undagrid solutions in their network and IT infrastructure• Configure and administer the platform independently, including tenant creation, user management, dashboard setup, reporting and minor customizations to meet customer requirements• Deliver technical and operational training for customer teams, from end users to administrators and IT stakeholders• Travel to customer sites when needed to support deployments, training, workshops, troubleshooting and business reviews• Validate our solutions in the field and at customer sites, identify technical problems and drive them to resolution• Collect customer requirements and translate them into actionable improvements and product feedback, working closely with our sales, product marketing, product management and engineering teamsWhat we’re looking for• BSc in Computer Science, Engineering, or a relevant field, combined with 5–10 years of experience in the asset tracking, IoT, RTLS, telematics, or related industries• Solid understanding of both indoor and outdoor tracking technologies: BLE-based indoor positioning and proximity tracking, GPS/GNSS-based outdoor tracking, as well as cellular IoT, telematics and fleet tracking concepts• Experience working with asset tracking platforms, dashboards, analytics and customer reporting, as well as with tools such as Grafana, git and Jira• Experience in installing and configuring network equipment, ideally in the field of aviation or logistics• Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving skills across hardware, connectivity and software domains• Good understanding of business processes and operational use cases, enabling you to discuss both technical capabilities and business value with customers• Ability to communicate effectively with everyone from operational users and IT departments to senior management, paired with a hands-on, problem-solving attitude in direct customer contact• Willingness to travel worldwide and to adjust your working schedule to support customers in different time zones• Fluent English is a must, additional language skills are a plusWhat we offer and what you can expect• Flexible working hours, well balanced work-life ratio• Work in an international and interdisciplinary team with great spirit• Freedom to express and develop yourself• Be part of a company that develops innovative technology for a greener world

jobs.occupation: Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware Production (Qualitätsmanager/in)
jobs.description: html Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware ProductionTaufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employeeBlackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.Quality Manager (all genders) in Space Hardware ProductionTaufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIESTHE WHYAt Blackwave, we develop and manufacture Composite Overwrapped Pressure Vessels and carbon fiber structures for the space industry — hardware where failure is not an option. As we scale from one site in Germany to two with our new facility in Texas, quality can't be an afterthought or a paper exercise. We're looking for a Quality Manager who builds a pragmatic, ISO 9001-compliant Quality Management System from the ground up for our Texas site, keeps our German QMS sharp, and creates a quality culture that engineers, operators, and management actually live — not one that gathers dust in a document folder.THE WHAT- Own ISO 9001 at both sites: Maintain certification in Germany and establish it in Texas, preparing all audits — internal, certification, and customer — together with the teams so they're passed without major findings. Blackwave Code: High Performance- Build processes people actually use: Define and implement essential quality processes that are pragmatic and scalable enough for development, manufacturing, and management to apply confidently in daily work. Blackwave Code: Togetherness- Make performance visible: Give leadership clear, up-to-date visibility into company performance through meaningful KPIs and management reviews that drive decisions rather than just report numbers. Blackwave Code: Candor- Own risk end-to-end: Establish and actively maintain a company-wide risk management system covering organizational, process, and product risks — with clear ownership and follow-up on mitigations. Blackwave Code: Accountability- Digitize quality: Establish a digital QMS platform as the mandatory system of record, with quality documentation and workflows fully migrated and adopted across the organization. Blackwave Code: PlayfulnessYOUR PROFILE- 3–5+ years of experience in quality management within a manufacturing environment — you've stood on a shop floor, not just in an office- Degree in a technical field (e.g. aerospace or mechanical engineering) plus relevant further training in quality management- Hands-on ISO 9001 experience: you've managed audit cycles and can walk us through a process you set up yourself, end to end- Pragmatic quality mindset: you build processes for usage, not just for compliance — standards are an enabler, not bureaucracy- Builder mentality: you create structures from scratch rather than maintaining what's already there, and you see a bit of chaos as an opportunity- Strong ownership and communication at all levels — from C-level to operator- Fluent English is a must; German is a plusWHAT WE OFFER- Freedom to Create: Extensive decision-making freedom and short decision paths – we trust your expertise to lead your team.- Fresh Fuel Every Day: Shared lunch breaks with freshly prepared, varied meals to keep the team energized.- Coffee Culture @ Blackwave: Enjoy premium coffee from our portafilter machine or join one of our barista courses.- Choose Your Perk: Select from a Deutschland-Ticket, EGYM Wellpass, or a Give Card.- Gear up for Take-off: Receive premium Blackwave team apparel during your on boarding.- Grow in Aerospace: Expand your professional horizons in a high-growth company at the forefront of space technology.- Rooftop Relaxation: End your day on our spacious rooftop terrace with a panoramic view of the Alps.Please refer to reference number YF-51680 for your application.Apply for this job

html Full-Cycle Sales – Space Tech (all genders)Taufkirchen, Garching / Full-time / Permanent employee About usBlackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. jobs.occupation: Industry Development Manager (f/m/d) - Waste & Circular Economy (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description: As the Industry Development Manager (f/m/d) - Waste & Circular Economy, you will play an integral role in shaping and growing Siemens' presence in one of the world's most dynamic and purpose-driven markets. The waste and recycling sector — spanning smart waste infrastructure, material recovery, waste-to-energy, and circular economy solutions — represents a significant and fast-growing opportunity, and Siemens is committed to becoming a leading technology partner within it.This is your opportunity to build something meaningful. You will be the driving force behind Siemens' waste vertical commercial growth, working directly alongside regional sales teams across Europe and the US to convert market access into closed deals and long-term customer relationships. Bringing deep waste domain expertise — across processes, procurement cycles, techno-commercial dynamics, and key industry players — you will be the credible expert voice that customers trust and that internal teams rely on to win.We are looking for an entrepreneurial market developer who combines genuine waste industry knowledge with a relentless commercial drive — who thrives on building pipeline, opening doors, and closing business in a complex, multi-stakeholder environment.What we offer you- Attractive remuneration package- 30 leave days and a variety of flexible working models that allow time off for yourself and your family- Share matching programs to become a shareholder of Siemens AG- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date- Innovative Environment: Be part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvementSince each of over 300,000 employees feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/benefits-was-wir-bieten.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.You'll make an impact by- Develop and execute the waste vertical go-to-market strategy, including portfolio positioning and the market introduction of Siemens' waste solutions- Drive pipeline creation and execution as the primary waste expert counterpart to regional sales teams, embedding directly in priority markets to accelerate opportunities from qualification to close- Lead and support customer engagements with major waste operators, municipalities, and OEMs, bringing the process knowledge, procurement understanding, and techno-commercial fluency to engage at every level- Coordinate cross-Business Unit activities to deliver a unified Siemens approach to the waste market and maximize share of wallet across the full waste value chain through verticalized offerings- Translate industry knowledge into sales enablement, equipping regional teams with the waste-specific tools, language, and insights needed to compete and win- Translate deep waste industry knowledge into portfolio requirements to shape Siemens' offering development and ensure solutions are positioned to win in the waste market- Monitor market trends and competitor positioning to keep Siemens' approach relevant, compelling, and differentiating- Feed customer and market insights into offering development, helping shape the next generation of Siemens solutions for the waste sectorThis is how you'll win us over- Education: Completed vocational training with further qualification as master/technician, extensive expertise and long-term, diverse professional experience; alternatively, completed bachelor's degree with long-term professional experience or completed master's degree with several years of professional experience- Experience and Skills:- Deep waste domain expertise – hands-on process knowledge combined with a strong understanding of industry procurement cycles, techno-commercial dynamics, and key stakeholder landscapes- A commercial mindset – proven track record of pipeline development, opportunity management, and closing business in complex, multi-stakeholder industrial environments- Customer credibility confident and compelling in senior and technical engagements with waste operators, municipalities, system integrators, and OEMs- Entrepreneurial drive — comfortable operating in a space that is being actively built, with the initiative to create structure and momentum where neither yet fully exists- Willingness to travel regularly across priority regions- Languages: English mandatory; German and other languages a strong advantageYou are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About UsThe world never stands still. And new challenges arise every day. With a passion for questioning things, for supplying ideas, and intelligently driving things forward we are helping society move towards a smarter tomorrow. Be it with technologies that reduce carbon emissions in cities or hyperintelligent robots. This is how we are able, to tackle the most important projects and push them forward together. Help us shape the future.www.siemens.de/careers (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/jobs/faq/) – if you need further information on the application process.
